data.title: Pay £4,800 more into your pension and save £1,920 in tax
data.description: Pension contributions get tax relief at your highest rate. £4,800 of your income is taxed at 40%, so paying that amount into a pension saves £1,920 this year. A workplace scheme gives the relief through your pay; for a personal pension the provider adds 20% and you claim the rest through Self Assessment.
why: £4,800 of your income is taxed at 40%
Pension contributions get tax relief at that 40% rate
